command_comparison: exact kind, vx, vyaw; unrounded brain outputs

citation.scope: Saved deterministic-twin pixel event; not scorer contact time or a physical-robot result.
citation.tick_alignment: Matched the tick explicitly cited by saved contact evidence.

mode: open-loop decision divergence; not an outcome proof
recorded_comparison: upstream tolerance: same kind, abs(speed delta) < 1e-4

suite_analysis.classification_policy: Classify on the prefix ending at the first exact different command. discrete-decision-before-impact requires a pre-impact first different command and B's differential stop/in-place turn or protective state while A stays forward, with no earlier different command. Earlier continuous steering makes the result continuous-only (inconclusive), even if a later state differs before impact. Without a command difference strictly before the cited impact tick, classify no-divergence-before-impact. No numerical threshold replaces exact equality.
suite_analysis.interpretation: B changes a discrete decision on the shared prefix before the saved event; this remains decision evidence, not evidence of avoiding the outcome.

time_origin: t is the original input timestamp; elapsed_s is t minus first input timestamp
why_B_meaning: upstream input safety/hold reason when holding; null otherwise; no avoidance reason exposed
